scenario: We enable sending to a friend before they finish their side (or their server needs AUTHINFO first): MODE STREAM draws 502/480, fn stops the peer. The friend fixes their side; we run 'peer set friend --streaming false' or 'peer login' as the log line says. Nothing is dialled until a restart; queued articles wait and their 431/loss attempts are not even tried.
title: A peer stopped for refusing MODE STREAM stays stopped after the operator's remedy until the node restarts
